scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; 14 financing, grant, credit and ownership events for 11 companies approved pending rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: Czech de minimis register records CZK419,000 foreign-marketing support for RETIA

rounds.note_en: The Czech state-aid record names RETIA, the grant purpose, original-currency amount and provision date. A provider name is not exposed on the checked page and is not invented.
rounds.coverage_note_en: This company-specific award is recorded. Other RETIA project pages lack award-level company amounts.

sources.title: Revobeam confirms PLN1,357,675.13 of EU funding for its antenna R&D project
Regional programme selection list confirms Revobeam and the final grant amount

rounds.note_en: The company-specific contribution is recorded, not the PLN1.9655m total project value. The dated programme selection list is used for month precision.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The verified project grant is recorded. Earlier cumulative grant and accelerator figures remain unreconciled as discrete events.

sources.title: Rift raises EUR4.6m led by AlleyCorp with OVNI Capital
OVNI Capital confirms participation in Rift's EUR4.6m round alongside AlleyCorp

rounds.note_en: The EUR4.6m round is attributed to the French aerial-infrastructure company Rift, not the unrelated Norwegian Rift Dynamics.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The verified 2025 round is recorded; any undisclosed earlier financing remains unknown.

sources.title: Ondas filing reports USD587,250 paid for approximately 10% of Rift Dynamics
Ondas announces its strategic Rift Dynamics investment and partnership

rounds.note_en: Ondas later disclosed the exact purchase price and approximate stake. The filing describes a purchased non-controlling interest; primary-versus-secondary proceeds are not established and the amount is not presented as primary issuer funding.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The verified ownership investment is recorded with its exact consideration and qualification.

sources.title: UKRI records GBP207,162 SUREAL award to Rinicom

rounds.note_en: UKRI attributes the award directly to Rinicom and gives the March 2021 to September 2022 project period.
rounds.coverage_note_en: One of Rinicom's company-specific public awards is recorded; the wider EU and UK history remains partial.

sources.title: UKRI records GBP192,867 ATOM award to Rinicom

rounds.note_en: UKRI attributes the award directly to Rinicom and gives the November 2022 to January 2024 project period.
rounds.coverage_note_en: This award is kept separate from other company-specific grants.

sources.title: UKRI records GBP553,687 ESCORT Horizon Europe Guarantee award to Rinicom

rounds.note_en: UKRI attributes the guarantee-backed award directly to Rinicom and gives the January 2024 to December 2026 project period.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Rinicom has further EU-funded projects; they require project-by-project source reconciliation rather than an aggregate artificial event.

sources.title: Final Frontier announces investment supporting Robotto's Ukrainian subsidiary
Robotto confirms signing an investment agreement with Final Frontier and EIFO support

rounds.note_en: The amount and exact EIFO instrument are undisclosed. Final Frontier is recorded as the explicitly named investor; EIFO support is retained in the note without inventing an equity role.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The signed amount-undisclosed investment is recorded.

sources.title: Siemens confirms completion of the sale of Roke to Chemring
Chemring announces GBP55m cash consideration for Roke

rounds.note_en: The GBP55m was consideration paid to Siemens for the entire issued share capital of Roke. It is a completed secondary ownership transaction and not primary proceeds to Roke.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The completed ownership event is recorded without treating the purchase price as issuer funding.

sources.title: Rolls-Royce confirms completion of GBP2bn new equity recapitalisation

rounds.note_en: Rolls-Royce described the completed rights issue as GBP2bn of new equity. Separate multi-currency bonds and the bank facility are not merged into this event.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The primary equity component of the 2020 recapitalisation is recorded at company-reported precision.

sources.title: RSI Europe confirms EUR117,337.50 ERDF funding for export expansion

rounds.note_en: The company-specific funding amount is recorded, not the EUR234,838 project budget.
rounds.coverage_note_en: A later EUR29.5m joint project with Odin Defence is held because the beneficiary split is not published; RSI's planned EUR50m own investment is not external financing.

sources.title: Saab confirms approximately SEK6.006bn proceeds from its oversubscribed rights issue

rounds.note_en: Saab reported approximately MSEK6,006 before issue costs; individual subscribing shareholders are not inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The completed primary equity raise is recorded.

sources.title: Saab debt-market page records its SEK6bn revolving credit facility

rounds.note_en: Saab names 11 relationship banks but does not publish individual commitments or arranger roles, so the facility is recorded without invented participant allocations.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The committed facility is kept distinct from the 2018 equity raise and the later EMTN programme.

sources.title: Safran announces EUR729.9999m nominal OCEANE placement and 14 June settlement
Safran 2025 financial statements confirm EUR756m total issue price

rounds.note_en: Safran's financial statements report EUR756m total issue price for EUR730m nominal OCEANEs issued at 103.5% of par. The issue-price proceeds are recorded; subsequent conversions and redemption are not new financing.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2021 convertible financing is recorded separately from refinanced predecessor bonds.
